column1: # P2 — Portion monotonicity. SAME food at INCREASING known weights
#   Cal.ai  -> guesses portion from pixels -> expected to stay ~flat (ignores real grams)
#   CalEyeZ -> measures grams -> expected to ride the truth diagonal (kcal grows with weight)
# Weigh each portion on our BLE scale; keep the camera roughly constant so weight is the only change.
# gt_kcal / error / slope are computed by repeatability_analysis.py.
#   true_weight_g      real grams on our BLE scale for THIS portion (this is what we vary)
#   gt_per100_kcal     kcal per 100 g (constant within a food)
#   calai_kcal         Cal.ai reported total kcal for this portion
#   caleyez_kcal       CalEyeZ reported total kcal for this portion
#   screenshot         filename of the result screenshots
